title: Live: French PM meets with student groups; may replace Parcoursup admissions platform within 2 years
summary: Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu will meet with high school groups this evening about a proposal to replace higher education admissions platform Parcoursup within two years. President Emmanuel Macron earlier said public order would be maintained without the need for a state of emergency, while noting it was not “off-limits" if “things were to deteriorate".…
contentText: Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu will meet with high school groups this evening about a proposal to replace higher education admissions platform Parcoursup within two years. President Emmanuel Macron earlier said public order would be maintained without the need for a state of emergency, while noting it was not “off-limits" if “things were to deteriorate". Follow our live blog for all the latest updates.
